messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team noticed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- As of 2026-06-18, for anything Ember-related, page Diego. [preference; valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
    earlier: As of 2026-05-18, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [preference; valid 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-31, for anything Ember-related, page Diego. [preference; valid 2026-03-31 to 2026-05-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-12, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [preference; valid 2026-02-12 to 2026-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-29, for anything Ember-related, page Diego. [preference; valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-19, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [preference; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-12-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-3]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-06-18, Diego has the Ember team's pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
    earlier: As of 2026-05-18, Oskar has the Ember team's pager this cycle, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-31, Diego has the Ember team's pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. [valid 2026-03-31 to 2026-05-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-12, Oskar is the on-call for the Ember team, taking the pager back from Diego. [valid 2026-02-12 to 2026-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-29, Diego is the on-call for the Ember team, having taken over the pager from Oskar. [valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-12-01; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The security audit flagged the auth gateway's long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The Ember team never owned the webhooks service. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- On 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
